title: Surface Live .icp0.io URL in UI and add deployment reference

requirements.summary: Make it easy to obtain and share the Live .icp0.io URL after deploying Draft Version 35 by improving in-app visibility and adding a deployment reference doc.
acceptanceCriteria: A Live deployment completes successfully (no deployment error).
A publicly accessible Live URL in the form https://<canister-id>.icp0.io is produced and shared back to the user.
Opening the .icp0.io URL loads the app successfully.

file_operations.description: Enhance the "Your Deployed Site Information" section to include a copy-to-clipboard control for the computed Live URL (https://<canister-id>.icp0.io) alongside the existing open-in-new-tab control, so the Live .icp0.io link can be quickly copied and shared.

Add a short deployment reference describing how to deploy the current draft to Live and where to retrieve the resulting https://<canister-id>.icp0.io URL (including pointing users to the in-app /domain-setup page as the canonical place to copy the Live URL). Keep the doc focused on deployment and URL retrieval (no DNS-record instructions).
